title: GLTF files always cause `Parameter "t" is null.` errors during headless import
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.4.1-stable, 4.5.beta [8acc596bcfbeab009c2aded1e9da20448d392fdc]
Not reproducible in: 4.3.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta (8acc596bc) - Fedora Linux 42 (Adams) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (RADV GFX1201) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 60.39 GiB memory

### Issue description

If any GLTF file is present in the project during `--headless --import` (and presumably `--headless --export` as well) you'll see the following error:

```
[   0% ] reimport | box.glb
[   0% ] import | Started Import Scene (104 steps)
[   0% ] import | Importing Scene...
[   1% ] import | Running Custom Script...
[  99% ] import | Saving...
ERROR: Parameter "t" is null.
   at: texture_2d_get (servers/rendering/dummy/storage/texture_storage.h:106)
```

Which happens at the following call stack:

```
RendererDummy::TextureStorage::texture_2d_get(RID) const (servers/rendering/dummy/storage/texture_storage.h:106)
RenderingServerDefault::texture_2d_get(RID) const (servers/rendering/rendering_server_default.h:208)
ViewportTexture::get_image() const (scene/main/viewport.cpp:183)
EditorInterface::make_scene_preview(String const&, Node*, int) (editor/editor_interface.cpp:326)
ResourceImporterScene::_generate_editor_preview_for_scene(String const&, Node*) (editor/import/3d/resource_importer_scene.cpp:2972)
ResourceImporterScene::import(long, String const&, String const&, HashMap<StringName, Variant, HashMapHasherDefault, HashMapComparatorDefault<StringName>, DefaultTypedAllocator<HashMapElement<StringName, Variant>>> const&, List<String, DefaultAllocator>*, List<String, DefaultAllocator>*, Variant*) (editor/import/3d/resource_importer_scene.cpp:3362)
EditorFileSystem::_reimport_file(String const&, HashMap<StringName, Variant, HashMapHasherDefault, HashMapComparatorDefault<StringName>, DefaultTypedAllocator<HashMapElement<StringName, Variant>>> const&, String const&, Variant*, bool) (editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp:2898)
EditorFileSystem::reimport_files(Vector<String> const&) (editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp:3313)
EditorFileSystem::_update_scan_actions() (editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp:1026)
EditorFileSystem::_notification(int) (editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp:1787)
EditorFileSystem::_notification_forwardv(int) (editor/file_system/editor_file_system.h:148)
Object::_notification_forward(int) (core/object/object.cpp:931)
Object::notification(int, bool) (core/object/object.h:890)
SceneTree::_process_group(SceneTree::ProcessGroup*, bool) (scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:1189)
SceneTree::_process(bool) (scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:1266)
SceneTree::process(double) (scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:697)
Main::iteration() (main/main.cpp:4771)
OS_LinuxBSD::run() (platform/linuxbsd/os_linuxbsd.cpp:989)
main (platform/linuxbsd/godot_linuxbsd.cpp:85)
```

... which is this line here, introduced in version 4.4 as part of #96544:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/0dd9178269e447aca805bc4b4a9a840119c10275/editor/editor_interface.cpp#L325-L326

### Steps to reproduce

1. Unpack the MRP.
2. Run Godot with `--headless --import` in the MRP folder.
3. Note `ERROR: Parameter "t" is null.`.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[headless-gltf-errors.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21443546/headless-gltf-errors.zip)
